title: Null control: Tokyo temp vs STNG
hypothesis: R2 | [oil-shipping] Null control: Tokyo daily mean temperature 20d z-score > 1 has no relation to tanker equity returns at 0-5 day lags (0); no trade [weather.tokyo.temp_mean -> finance.STNG.log_return]
message: Null control holds: Tokyo temp z>1 vs STNG r=0.02 (n=387), validity 0, OOS hit 35%; no trade

trade_idea.entry_rule: weather.tokyo.temp_mean rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> long STNG next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 3 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.
